creativeThesis: Read the digital surface while the original stays closed.
viewerExperience: Encounter an inaccessible message, follow the geometric and signal route, return to a readable image beside the unchanged object.
emotionalTarget: Curiosity, intellectual satisfaction and respect for fragile evidence.
visualThesis: One highlighted surface and its sample marks survive the representation change; no actual artifact unrolls.

decisions.treatment: Original vector conservation workbench with closed charred object, slice view, traced colored layer and connected surface-to-plane transformation.
decisions.rationale: Show how information changes representation while its fragile carrier remains closed.
alternativesConsidered: Archive documentary using real photographs and scan footage.
Pure black-and-white typographic puzzle: hidden words become visible through a virtual page.

decisions.treatment: Pearl-gray field, charcoal material, one red-orange traced surface; full-width explanatory work rather than decorative archive sepia.
decisions.rationale: Contrast material and digital representation; the accent tracks a single layer, not a history category.

decisions.treatment: Kokoro af_heart at 0.97; full semantic sentences, gently curious opening and deliberate material boundary.
decisions.rationale: Current auditory continuity; typography never drives clip generation.

decisions.treatment: Manrope 48px/600 near-black, two-line natural phrases on clear lower field; fixed glyphs with restrained opacity.
decisions.rationale: Quiet large speech retains limitations while the diagram transforms above.

decisions.treatment: Voice and deliberate silence only; no scanner beeps, fire crackles or music.
decisions.rationale: No authentic-sounding fictional apparatus or distraction from layer continuity.

decisions.treatment: Runtime measured from connected narration plus short semantic pauses and final hold.
decisions.rationale: Each spatial transformation gets time to be understood; no monetization padding.

decisions.treatment: Show closed charred object and glimpse a digital image as the impossible-task statement begins.
decisions.rationale: Resolve a real obstacle; no fake hidden Bible mystery or destroyed-writing restoration.

decisions.treatment: 1080×1920 / 30fps, inset-aware critical region; four independently bound provisional profiles.
decisions.rationale: Designed captions and actual-media sampled preflight, with native/mobile/crop unknowns retained.

recentAssets.learnedPrinciple: Make a hidden relationship visible, preserve speech and truth boundaries.
recentAssets.applicability: Use continuity and readable speech; independently choose environment and geometry.
similarities: Original faceless explanation and primary narrator.
A vertical composition with speech beneath an explanatory field.
differences: Full-width conservation workbench carries one layer through transformations.
The persistent unchanged artifact anchors the difference between object and representation.
recentAssets.rationale: Local SVG/caption machinery is reusable, but central object/title theatre could be inherited by convenience. Documentary and pure-type alternatives considered before choosing the connected surface route.

dimensions.observed: Dark blue metal-and-water macro, paired drops, enlarged contact diagram, lower white speech, recurrent central stage.
dimensions.proposed: Wide surface tracing and flattening with material/volume/image distinction.

dimensions.observed: Designed lower captions with primary narration.
dimensions.proposed: Large dark speech on pearl field; voice-only mix.

similarityCauses.similarity: SVG central-object theatre is the easiest implementation route.
similarityCauses.justification: Explicitly recognized tooling bias, evaluated materially different approaches.

alternatives.treatment: Archive documentary using real photographs and scan footage.
materialChanges: Observed fragile material and actual apparatus instead of schematic artwork.
Photographic editorial montage instead of continuous geometric transformation.
alternatives.storyTradeoffs: Gives authenticity but available article photo/figures have CC BY-NC terms; no reusable commercial footage established. No copying; retain as future option with rights.

alternatives.treatment: Pure black-and-white typographic puzzle: hidden words become visible through a virtual page.
materialChanges: Use expressive page-scale typography and directional reading reveal.
alternatives.storyTradeoffs: Immediate idea but risks implying guessed text or magical recovery, and obscures how curved surfaces connect to scan data.

convenienceResponse.resolution: Use connected conservation-workbench transformation; no repeated large title resets or scan-themed HUD.
convenienceResponse.chosenForStory: The viewer must follow a surface through a volume to an image. Original illustration provides that causal continuity without false data or unresolved borrowed-image rights.

convergenceReview.conclusion: Similarity in engineering, voice and accessibility is justified; representation continuity and material boundary select the scene language independently of tooling.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four latest approved masters by actual decision-entry time under recentApprovedVisualWorks; same asset excluded, no published/popular filtering.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: Light full-width conservation explanation, black fragile material versus red traced digital surface, restrained dark speech; understood as information recovery rather than a small artifact on a stage.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Existing SVG and fixed lower captions were challenged with documentary and pure-type treatments; selected geometry is needed to expose the mechanism, not because a renderer exists.

ownerReview.rationale: Routine existing-cost original production with inspected central evidence, neutral cultural identification and cleared existing rights; Master Review remains first owner gate.

risks: Illustrative marks are not Hebrew or extracted evidence.
Charcoal and layers are schematics, not measured morphology.
Different materials/inks require different scan and extraction methods.
No exact-media real-device or crop proof.

provenance.notes: Session-authored judgments and actual overview-image inspection, no provider envelope or owner approval.
